_comment: Tile coords are grid-centred (0,0 = middle of the forecourt). Customers queue on queue[0..] in order; queue[0] is nearest the counter. Machines live in machines.json. An order may ask for sprinkles ("<flavour>+sprinkles"): shake them on at the sprinkle shaker; it pays extras.sprinkles more. Sprinkles on an order that didn't ask earn a small tip. Tier-2 extras: a velvet base (smokehouse -> velvet churn -> scoop) and a waffle wrap (waffle iron). Special customers (vip) come once you hold conquered land: they order specialities, wait patienceMul longer and pay priceMul more. Staff: servants walk at speed tiles/s, take slow x your hold time (fishing and baking: cycleSec x 0.5), earn 1 xp per sale or store drop-off, need xpPerLevel x level xp per level up to maxLevel, and follow level + 1 machines (stores are free). They rest at `rest`. From fixLevel they fix a jammed machine on their plan themselves (fixSec x slow).
